tasks.title: IPC fullscreen bridge
tasks.description: Add Electron IPC + preload APIs so Present can request enter/exit fullscreen on its own BrowserWindow (macOS native setFullScreen).

tasks.title: Present F uses native
tasks.description: On Electron Present, F enters/exits via the bridge. Do not call requestFullscreen on Electron. Browser Present keeps HTML requestFullscreen.

tasks.title: Stronger simpleFullscreen fallback
tasks.description: If after native fullscreen the Mac menu bar still remains visible or native FS fails, fall back to setSimpleFullScreen while preserving easy exit.

tasks.title: Easy F and Escape exit
tasks.description: F and Escape always leave fullscreen (native or fallback) and restore windowed Present; no hard kiosk lock.

tasks.title: No auto-FS on open
tasks.description: Opening a Present window stays windowed; fullscreen only after operator F.

tasks.title: Window-scoped only
tasks.description: Fullscreen applies only to existing Present BrowserWindows on the display they already occupy; no display-picker UI.

tasks.title: Automated bridge checks
tasks.description: Add automated coverage for Electron bridge enter/exit native vs fallback routing; browser still uses HTML FS.

tasks.title: Release notes bullet
tasks.description: Release-notes bullet for Mac Present fullscreen reliability and System Settings / fallback note.
